description: This file implements a wrapper and helper functions for Android's IServiceManager interface, including a shim class for service management, registration, and notification handling, with support for host and device environments.

classes.name: ServiceManagerShim
classes.description: A shim class implementing IServiceManager, providing methods to get, check, add, list, wait for services, and manage notifications.

classes.name: ServiceManagerHostShim
classes.description: A host-specific subclass of ServiceManagerShim for remote service management.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves a service by name, waiting up to a timeout if necessary.

methods.name: checkService
methods.description: Checks if a service is available without waiting.

methods.name: addService
methods.description: Adds a new service to the service manager.

methods.name: listServices
methods.description: Lists all available services with a given priority.

methods.name: waitForService
methods.description: Waits for a service to become available, registering for notifications.

methods.name: isDeclared
methods.description: Checks if a service is declared.

methods.name: getDeclaredInstances
methods.description: Retrieves instances of a given interface.

methods.name: updatableViaApex
methods.description: Checks if a service is updatable via APEX.

methods.name: getUpdatableNames
methods.description: Gets names of updatable services within an APEX.

methods.name: getConnectionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves connection info for a service.
